notes.title: UPDATE : V.0.7.3.2.4
notes.content:
[h3]UPDATE :  V.0.7.3.2.4[/h3][p]o [b]Patch Update Highlights[/b] o[/p][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Weather System[/b]: Experience a living world with changing weather conditions that add atmosphere and unpredictability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Time of Day Cycle[/b]: The game world now shifts smoothly through [b]morning[/b], [b]evening[/b], and [b]night[/b], bringing new visual depth and strategic variation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New BloodMoon Event[/b]: Prepare yourself for a chilling new challenge—[b]a formidable enemy emerges[/b] under the ominous red sky of the BloodMoon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved AI RAID Behavior[/b]: Significant adjustments have been made to enemy AI during nighttime raids, resulting in more intense and action-packed encounters while introducing new attack patterns and improved offensive capabilities against players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced Dodge Mechanics[/b]: A perfectly timed [b]Perfect Dodge[/b] now drastically reduces incoming damage, rewarding skilled players with higher survivability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Event Music[/b]: New adaptive soundtrack elements respond to gameplay scenarios, heightening emotional moments and in-game tension.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refined User Interface[/b]: We’ve updated the [b]player HUD[/b], revamped the [b]Settings Menu[/b], and fine-tuned other UI elements to enhance usability and visual clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p]💬 [b]A Message from the Developers [/b]💬[/p][p]First and foremost, we would like to express our sincere gratitude for all the feedback and reviews you’ve shared. We also wish to extend our heartfelt apology to anyone who may have been disappointed or upset by certain decisions we’ve made. Please know that it was never our intention to cause frustration.[/p][p]As many of you are aware, the current state of the game may not be ideal, and we fully acknowledge that. However, we remain committed to continuous improvement and development. While this may not be a widely popular or high-profile title, we are a small indie team that deeply values every comment and critique from our players.[/p][p]We are here to listen, learn, and grow.[/p][p]Our Commitment to You :
[b]“We will never abandon you.”
Every one of you matters deeply to us, and your support continues to inspire our journey. No matter the challenges ahead, we’re here to stay, to grow, and to build this world together with you.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We warmly invite you to join our [b]Discord community[/b], where you can become part of the journey—helping us shape the future of this game and fostering a welcoming space for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]🙏Thank you for your continued support. We can’t wait to hear what you think of this update🙏[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45331338/4f7ea817f639615e1df13bf30c858d33779dda35.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update : V.0.7.3.2.2
notes.content:
[h3]Update : V.0.7.3.2.2[/h3]

o Update Patch o

[list]
[*]  Added two presets, male and female, at the game's start.
[*]  Introduced new weapons and adjusted the required materials and quantities for crafting. Some weapons now require payment to craft. Basic weapons can be crafted for free at the Weapon Station, while mid-to-high-tier weapons can be crafted at the Blacksmith, with a crafting fee. Additionally, some equipment also requires payment to craft and can be crafted at the Equipment Vendor in the village.
[*]  Improved the UI windows
[*]  Adjusted Hunger & Thirst to deplete more slowly.
[*]  Enhanced and refined the village environment.
[*]  Updated idle and running animations for both male and female characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.7.3.1.0 : Rebuild Gameplay & More Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Update [ 0.7.3.1.0 ][/h3]
Change Gameplay to full survivor fantasy fairy tale (No Base Defended).
" In this update, we have changed the gameplay style from [b]Base Defense[/b] to [b]Full Survival[/b]. Now, you can feel hunger and thirst, and you need to find food and water to survive. However, hunger will not kill you but will instead reduce the player's status.Additionally, we have expanded the landscape to provide a larger area for players to build their residences.And improved the combat animations and optimized some assets that were overused."

Update Patch 0.7.3.1.0 :
[list]
[*] Expanded the map size
[*] Hunger and thirst system
[*] Added a water well for crafting drinking water
[*] Fixed combat animations
[*] Optimize actor's hiding distance.
[/list]
